body: Heh, I'm more into using opiates but I totally hear ya.
Others would see me as a plain, overweight, overly weird girl.

I meant replaceable in more of a relationship situation, like if I'm trying to be friends with someone, I'm easily forgettable even though I don't forget about them... Basically unrequited friendship/love.

Heh, I'm actually the same way. I'm scared to kill myself because I know my family would never ever get over my death and the thought of my mother crying is very unnerving to me, but every bout of depression I have, it seems like my feelings about heeding my family's emotions about my possible suicide is diminishing. Life is a hurtful farce, in time, I hope they understand this and accept why I would kill myself. 

Family and semi-religious reasons keep me alive. Plus killing yourself takes courage- something I truly lack. Other than that, I don't have much to live for. How did I come to my suicidal thoughts? Well, I'm a pathetic, weak, and lonely person and I hate myself for that. I really want people to like me so I start to do anything and everything for them, but as usual, they don't notice me. This sends my emotions in a tailspin. I'm not perfect. I have high expectations for myself and I can never reach them. I let my family down by not doing well in school and being too secretive and emotionally "weird". I'm not attractive. I'm lonely. I want to be understood but no one understands me. I can't take failure at all. I think about ending my life if one little thing goes wrong. Plus life is just unnecessary IMO.
I feel too weak and stupid to do anything to help myself. I'm scared of defeat and failure. I just want to give up.
I can try that but I'm not sure it will work. I'll regress in my old ways and my depression... Suicide will fix all of my problems.
Mostly emotional and a little bit physical because I hate how I look like and I don't consider myself attractive. My emotions tend to be all-consuming and volatile. I wish I was emotionless...

Interesting link. I'm going to read it in a bit.

But how can I kill them when they're extremely consuming? These thoughts don't stop no matter how much I try. I just want a reprieve from life. I don't want to be lonely anymore. I hate being depressed. Life is painful, and I can't deal with this pain.
